name: trash
description: Safely move local files and directories into chat-scoped recoverable trash, inspect storage pressure, restore mistakes, and explicitly purge retained content.

retentionDays.prompt: Days trashed content remains eligible for cleanup.

minimumFreeBytes.prompt: Free bytes that must remain after a cross-filesystem trash or restore copy.

maxFilesystemUsagePercent.prompt: Maximum projected filesystem usage allowed for cross-filesystem copies.

allowCrossFilesystemCopy.prompt: Allow guarded copy-and-verify moves when atomic rename is impossible across filesystems.

protectedPaths.prompt: Additional absolute paths the trash tool must refuse to move.
